nodes.description: Mapping(address=>bool) tracking addresses authorized to mint and burn pToken.
Owner address stored in Ownable; set at construction and used by onlyOwner.
ERC20 balance mapping mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
ERC20 total supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
ERC20 allowance mapping read by transferFrom and written by _approve.
Public mint(address _to, uint256 _amount) restricted to authorized[msg.sender]; mints new tokens.
Public burn(address _from, uint256 _amount) restricted to authorized[msg.sender]; destroys tokens.
onlyOwner function adding an address to the authorized mapping.
onlyOwner function removing an address from the authorized mapping.
ERC20 public transfer; moves tokens from _msgSender() using _transfer.
ERC20 public transferFrom; moves tokens and decreases allowance.
View function returning the current owner address.
onlyOwner function setting _owner to address(0).
onlyOwner function updating _owner to a new address.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and as transfer sender.
Token creation: _mint(_to,_amount) increases supply and recipient balance.
Token destruction: _burn(_from,_amount) decreases supply and victim balance.
require(authorized[msg.sender],"Not authorized") gate protecting mint.
require(authorized[msg.sender],"Not authorized") gate protecting burn.
Ownable onlyOwner modifier: require(_owner == _msgSender()); owner-only access control.
Internal ERC20 mint routine updating _totalSupply and _balances.
Internal ERC20 burn routine updating _balances and _totalSupply.
Internal ERC20 transfer moving balances between accounts.
Internal ERC20 approve writing the _allowances mapping.
Parameter _to of mint; destination address of newly minted tokens.
Parameter _amount of mint; quantity of tokens created.
Parameter _from of burn; account whose tokens are destroyed.
Parameter _amount of burn; quantity of tokens destroyed.
Parameter _toAdd of addAuthorized; address granted mint/burn rights.
Parameter _toRemove of removeAuthorized; address stripped of mint/burn rights.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read by the mint authorization require statement.
authorized mapping is consulted to decide whether the caller may mint.
mint executes the authorized[msg.sender] check before any minting.
Mint execution is gated by the successful authorization require.
mint invokes the minting operation on its arguments.
Mint operation delegates to internal _mint routine.
_mint increases the recipient entry of the _balances mapping.
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable.
msg.sender is read by the burn authorization require statement.
authorized mapping is consulted to decide whether the caller may burn.
burn executes the authorized[msg.sender] check before destroying tokens.
Burn execution is gated by the successful authorization require.
burn invokes the burn operation on its arguments.
Burn operation delegates to internal _burn routine.
_burn decreases the target entry of the _balances mapping.
_burn decreases the _totalSupply state variable.
_msgSender()/msg.sender is compared against _owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
The stored _owner value is read by the onlyOwner equality check.
addAuthorized can only proceed past the onlyOwner modifier.
removeAuthorized can only proceed past the onlyOwner modifier.
addAuthorized writes true into the authorized mapping.
removeAuthorized writes false into the authorized mapping.
mint destination parameter flows into the minting operation.
mint amount parameter flows into the minting operation.
burn source parameter flows into the burn operation.
burn amount parameter flows into the burn operation.
_toAdd parameter is the address granted authorization.
_toRemove parameter is the address losing authorization.
transfer uses _msgSender(), which resolves to msg.sender, as the sender.
transfer delegates balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates balance movement to _transfer.
_transfer updates sender and recipient entries of _balances.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance consumption.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter of mint exists only to feed the minting operation, so it normalizes into the mint execution node.
The _amount parameter of mint is consumed solely by the minting operation and normalizes into it.
The _from parameter of burn is consumed solely by the burn operation and normalizes into it.
The _amount parameter of burn is consumed solely by the burn operation and normalizes into it.
The _toAdd parameter only feeds addAuthorized, so it normalizes into that owner function.
The _toRemove parameter only feeds removeAuthorized, so it normalizes into that owner function.
